send_telemetry_ping: send a telemetry ping event to the Hugging Face Hub
send_telemetry_gradio: send telemetry for gradio with library name and version
send_telemetry_transformers: send telemetry for transformers with library name, version, and user agent dict
start_telemetry_thread: start a daemon thread to consume telemetry tasks from the queue
send_telemetry_in_thread: send telemetry data to the Hub via HTTP HEAD request with built headers
